assets.alt: Four fictional adult women hug and reach toward one another on a Lake Sevan terrace, wearing short crimson, gold, red-blue-orange and green outfits with rainbow knee-highs, black RAZE boots and green pumps; fictional fires and smoke rise on distant hills.

Four fictional adult women relax around a terrace couch beside the monumental Pinecone Courtyard: one rests her head on another's shoulder, a third sits on the parapet and a fourth crouches beside them. They wear short gold, yellow-and-white Vatican flag and blue looks with metallic heels and rainbow platforms; distant fictional fires and smoke rise over the city.

Four fictional adult women lean together and join hands in the Vatican Gallery of Maps, wearing short blue, yellow-white flag and cartographic looks with rainbow knee-highs, gold platforms, a white boot, a blue RAZE boot and bronze stilettos.

caption: Armenia ❤️ Vatican City: Lake Sevan's sunlit terrace meets the Pinecone Courtyard and Gallery of Maps—three affectionate quartet moments in sharply short flag-cut couture, rainbow knee-highs, RAZE boots, metallic platforms and stilettos.
